title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: upgrade availability, list price and overdue threshold by product
content:
## Scope

This comparison lists, for each product of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, its rank on the product ladder and the settings that bear on buying more free time on a running per-container record.

## Settings per product

| Product | Rank | Purchasable as an upgrade | List price per container record | Upgrades a record may still take while on this product | Overdue balance threshold |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 1 | no | USD 0.00 | 1 | USD 1500.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 2 | yes | USD 95.00 | 1 | USD 1500.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 3 | yes | USD 195.00 | 1 | USD 2500.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 4 | yes | USD 245.00 | 1 | USD 5000.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 5 | yes | USD 395.00 | 1 | USD 5000.00 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 6 | no | USD 0.00 | 0 | USD 15000.00 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Rank**: the position of the product on the ladder, AHL Tariff Free Time being the lowest.
- **Purchasable as an upgrade**: whether the product may be bought on a running record in place of a lower product.
- **List price**: the list price of the product per container record, in USD.
- **Upgrades a record may still take**: the number of upgrades a record may still take while it carries this product.
- **Overdue balance threshold**: the customer's overdue demurrage and detention balance above which this product cannot be bought as an upgrade, in USD.

## Points of judgement

**Q: Can a customer buy AHL Contract Free Time 30 as an upgrade?**
A: No. It is not purchasable as an upgrade, and a record carrying it may take 0 further upgrades.

**Q: Which products can be bought as upgrades?**
A: AHL Free Time Extension 3, AHL Free Time Extension 7, AHL Combined Free Time 14 and AHL Combined Free Time 21.

**Q: What is the overdue balance threshold of AHL Free Time Extension 7?**
A: USD 2500.00.
